critique.evidence: Strong cyber-lab art direction, restrained red/cyan/yellow palette, commanding headline, and consistent card styling across viewports. However, desktop composition is overly tall and sparse, with the phylogeny graphic undersized inside a large empty panel. Tablet/mobile become dense and text-heavy; tiny mono labels and low-contrast secondary copy reduce legibility. The vaccination flow wraps awkwardly on tablet and loses its directional rhythm on mobile. The global header also feels clipped rather than intentionally responsive, with truncated navigation and no visible brand name on mobile; contrast remains unverified for 12 mobile header nodes and one tablet node.
critique.fix: Increase small-text size and contrast, enlarge/recompose the desktop phylogeny visualization, and tighten excessive vertical whitespace. Redesign the vaccination sequence as a deliberate mobile stepper. Give the header an explicit compact navigation treatment with a clear current-section cue and verify contrast at tablet/mobile widths.
